query: I am evaluating a 52-year-old woman with intracranial hemorrhage. Among female ICU patients aged 47–57 with ICH, what percentile does a first‑72‑hour vital‑sign instability score of 75 represent? Also report average ICU length of stay and mortality for the top decile.
final_sql: SELECT percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY instability) AS percentile_rank, average_length_of_stay, mortality_rate FROM patient_stats WHERE percentile_rank <= 0.1;
